pain_point: Tax and depreciation benefits unclear - I heard you get better tax deductions buying new but my accountant hasn't explained it properly
primary_text: "I heard you get better tax deductions buying new." You heard right. A brand-new warehouse lets you depreciate the full construction cost — both the building and every fixture inside it. Buy a second-hand shed and most of that benefit has already been claimed by previous owners. For a small business owner-occupier, the difference could be $15,000–$25,000 in annual deductions in the early years. That's real money back in your pocket at tax time. These off-the-plan Truganina warehouses maximise your depreciation position from settlement. We'll provide a depreciation estimate before you buy. Take it to your accountant. They'll get it.
description: Potential $15,000-$25,000 in annual depreciation deductions in early years
